purpose: Registry for grammar, syntax, linguistic structure, semantic engineering, Text Architecture, retrieval structure and KM/RAG analysis. Historical LOC7 identifiers are provenance only.

fields.era_id: Current ERA registry reference or null

boundary_note: Linguistic, retrieval and KM/RAG capabilities are reusable Features. They consume records inside a governed Scope without taking ownership of that Scope. Meaning/value/governance and temporal analysis are separate Features, not numbered-module owners.
historical_boundary: LOC7 is retained only as a Historical/provenance identifier in migration evidence; it is not Current architecture, filename identity or authority.
